tasks.notes: Fix Project_Tools.Text.Line_Value so values from CRLF files do not retain the carriage return, including a final CR without LF. Preserve LF, missing-key and empty-value behavior. Change only src/project_tools-text.adb; keep the public API and other functions unchanged.

Fix Project_Tools.TOML.Parse_String_After: an empty quoted value is Parsed_String with an empty value, not a reason to read a later occurrence of the key. Preserve nonempty, missing and malformed handling. Change only src/project_tools-toml.adb.

Add Project_Tools.TOML.Boolean_Parse_Status (Parsed_Boolean, Missing_Boolean, Malformed_Boolean), Boolean_Parse_Result with Status default Missing_Boolean and Value Boolean default False, and Parse_Boolean_After (Text, Key : String; From : Positive) returning that record. Follow the existing natural and string parser conventions: find Key at or after From, skip spaces, parse lowercase true or false, distinguish missing from malformed, return False on those outcomes, and contain Constraint_Error as malformed. Change only src/project_tools-toml.ads and .adb.

Fix Regexp character classes: literal p and P in [dp], [pq] and [^p] must compile as letters. A Unicode property inside brackets is written [\p{digit}], recognized after the escape; outside properties must keep working. Preserve ordinary classes and invalid-property diagnostics. Change only src/regexp.adb.

Fix Regexp so a backreference consumes its entire captured span, including groups longer than one character: (ab)\1 must fully match abab and reject abac. Preserve captures, alternatives, quantified groups and matching options. Keep ordinary patterns working and bound pathological backtracking using the existing match-limit result. Change only src/regexp.adb.

Fix Version.Ref_Names.Is_Valid_Ref_Name: valid multi-level ref names must not be restricted to an allowlist of familiar hierarchies. refs/pull/12/head, refs/bisect/good and vendor/topic are valid; retain grammar and path-safety rejection of malformed or unsafe names. Preserve the public API and branch/tag/remote validation. Change only src/version-ref_names.adb.
